subject: The clock of delimitation: what time should be set?
alt: Satish Acharya's cartoon: at the left stands a bald, bespectacled leader (in the manner of Amit Shah), holding a brown clock marked NCP, its hands drawn spinning. At the right a white-bearded leader (in the manner of Narendra Modi) smiles and holds a blue book marked DELIMITATION STRATEGY. The speech bubble from the leader at the left reads: WHAT TIME SHOULD I SET? and the leader at the right answers: GOOD TIME! The cartoonist's signature, SATISH ACHARYA, is at the bottom centre.
chutki: One leader holds a clock and asks: what time should I set? The other holds a book marked 'Delimitation Strategy' and answers: good time! The clock is marked NCP, which is to say the time is being set in a party's name.

The question, clearly, is not only of the clock but of its hands: when delimitation should come into force, whose time it is, and for whom it will be too late. The two cartoons are two ends of the same rope: hunger at one end, arithmetic at the other.
